subject: Request: SLO waiver + pricing adjustment for Starlight AI
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@starlight.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@starlight.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SLO request for production launch

Marcus —

Thanks for the call this morning. We’re targeting a hard launch the week of Apr 5 and need written confirmation on two non-standard items before procurement can sign:

1) An SLO waiver to accept 99.9% availability for the first 3 months of production rather than Redwood’s standard 99.99%.
2) A cap on service credits to one month of committed spend (Starlight requires a ceiling for billing predictability).

These changes are an ask from our security and procurement teams because of traffic patterns and data residency workstreams. If we can get executive signoff and a one-time onboarding discount to offset additional integration effort, Procurement will push the contract through DocuSign this week.

I’ve attached our internal launch calendar and a short procurement checklist.

–Elena

Attachments: starlight_launch_calendar.pdf (pdf), procurement_checklist.docx (docx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@starlight.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLO request for production launch

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask. Quick notes:
- We generally hold to 99.99% SLA for production tenants; switching to 99.9% is a non-standard operational/financial change and requires Deal Desk + an exec signoff for remedies and credit caps.
- We can consider a temporary 99.9% waiver for 90 days if Starlight accepts a reduced credit cap and a joint review at 60 days to assess traffic profile.
- As a commercial concession, I can offer a one-time onboarding credit (applied against first invoice) of $75,000 if Procurement signs within 7 days.

Looping in Laura (legal) and Aditya (revenue) to coordinate final language and approval path. I’ve attached a draft redline of the SLO clause with proposed credit cap language.

Thank you,
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachments: SLA_redline_Starlight_20260319.pdf (pdf), pricing_summary_v3.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLO request for production launch

Marcus —

I reviewed Elena’s requested redlines. Legal is OK with a temporary SLO waiver on these conditions:
- Waiver limited to 90 days starting from production readiness date.
- Service credit calculation limited to a single month of committed spend (as requested) and not to exceed the onboarding credit value ($75k).
- Mandatory joint operational review at day 60 and final remediation plan required prior to extension.

Two items require revenue/exec approval: (1) the one-time onboarding credit amount and (2) whether we accept the operational risk of a reduced SLO. Please confirm commercial approval so I can prepare the DocuSign package.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLO request for production launch — exec decision required

Team —

I reviewed the proposed concession. My thinking:
- Competitive imperative: Starlight is a strategic mid‑market AI customer with potential growth into Dedicated capacity in 2027.
- Financials: $75k onboarding credit looks acceptable against a 12‑month committed ARR of ~$1.35M (gross margin impact is small and recoverable).
- Risk: Temporary SLO waiver to 99.9% for 90 days is allowable if we enforce the credit cap and hard stop at 90 days with the joint review. No open-ended extensions without a new approval.

Approvals (from me):
1) Authorize onboarding credit up to $75,000.
2) Approve temporary SLO waiver to 99.9% for 90 days with a mandatory 60‑day operational review.

Please prepare the DocuSign with the agreed language and route to Finance to apply credit on first invoice. Laura, you have authority to finalize the legal redline per the terms above.

Aditya Rao
VP, Revenue Operations

[Forwarded thread]
> Laura Bennett: I reviewed Elena’s requested redlines...

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@starlight.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@starlight.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Final: SLO waiver + onboarding credit (DocuSign)

Elena/Raj —

Thanks for your patience. Per internal approvals, Redwood can commit to the following for Starlight’s initial production term: 

1) Temporary SLO waiver: Redwood will accept 99.9% availability for the initial 90‑day period starting on the production readiness date.
2) Service credits: Calculation will follow Section 5.2 (SLO remedies) but will be capped at the lesser of (a) one month of Starlight’s committed spend or (b) the onboarding credit amount ($75,000).
3) Onboarding credit: One-time credit of $75,000 applied to the first invoice.
4) Reviews & remedies: Joint operational review at day 60; any extension beyond 90 days requires renewed executive approval.

I’ve attached the final redline and routed the DocuSign envelope to Procurement for signature. Marcus, Finance will need the billing code to apply the credit — I’m copying Grace to coordinate.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SLA_redline_Starlight_20260322-final.pdf (pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@starlight.ai>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@starlight.ai>, procurement@starlight.ai

Subject: Signed & next steps — Starlight SLO waiver

Elena/Raj —

Great to get this across the line. We received the signed DocuSign envelope this afternoon. Next operational items:
- Production readiness checklist complete by Mar 29 (Starlight to confirm).
- Grace will own the billing coordination; onboarding credit will be reflected on the first invoice (billing code: ONB-STL-2026).
- Joint operational review scheduled for May 21 (day 60). I’ll send invites once Starlight confirms launch date.

Thanks everyone — excited to get Starlight live.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
